foregroundPolicy: The near-right crown blade is a fixed original occluder attached to the bulb. Three other leaf blades and two completed vines articulate independently; original overlaps behind the fixed near leaf never become exposed.

bodySoft.method: Continuous fleshy bulb attachment with two weighted controls. Root skin below y374 remains fixed; crown attachments translate with the bulb top and retain their own bends.

revision: Replace the whole-bulb tilt/lift with real local flesh compression and width redistribution above fixed roots; retain the independently bending leaves and completed vine attachments.

hiddenBulbRestoration.purpose: Restore the rounded native hidden bulb alpha behind the formerly occluding front leaf before flesh deformation. Original roots are restored after rendering.
hiddenBulbRestoration.rgb: Floating point normalized skin-lighting reconstruction with native hidden-surface texture detail; prevents quantized underpaint bands.

shoulderContour.method: Single continuous opaque skin surface using original exposed bulb contour and complete native hidden cap; removed old leaf-cut alpha branches and detached skin pixels.

verifiedGroundContacts.selection: Manually selected columns through visibly supporting toe/root pads, followed only to the local alpha edge; no bounding-box or tail selection.
verifiedGroundContacts.additionalContacts: All root pixels at and below the contact band are copied from the original artwork.
